title: A Record 202.9M Shoppers Turned Out Thanksgiving Weekend

facts.fact: The National Retail Federation (NRF) reported that a record 202.9 million consumers shopped over the five-day holiday weekend from Thanksgiving through Cyber Monday.
facts.quote: A record-breaking 202.9 million consumers shopped over the five-day holiday weekend from Thanksgiving through Cyber Monday

facts.fact: The NRF said the 2025 Thanksgiving weekend turnout exceeded the 197 million shoppers from the previous year.
facts.quote: This year’s turnout exceeded the 197 million shoppers last year

facts.fact: The NRF said the 2025 turnout surpassed the previous record of 200.4 million Thanksgiving weekend shoppers set in 2023.
facts.quote: surpassed the previous record of 200.4 million set in 2023

facts.fact: The NRF's initial expectation for Thanksgiving weekend shoppers was 186.9 million, which the final 2025 turnout beat.
facts.quote: It also beat the NRF’s initial expectations of 186.9 million shoppers over the holiday weekend.

facts.fact: Online shopping was the most popular option over the 2025 Thanksgiving weekend, with 134.9 million shoppers, per the NRF and Prosper Insights & Analytics survey.
facts.quote: Online shopping was the most popular option, with 134.9 million shoppers, up 9 percent year-over-year

facts.fact: Online Thanksgiving weekend shoppers rose 9 percent year-over-year in the 2025 NRF survey.
facts.quote: with 134.9 million shoppers, up 9 percent year-over-year

facts.fact: In-store Thanksgiving weekend shoppers totaled 129.5 million in the 2025 NRF survey.
facts.quote: while 129.5 million consumers shopped in stores, up 3 percent year-over-year.

facts.fact: In-store Thanksgiving weekend shoppers rose 3 percent year-over-year in the 2025 NRF survey.
facts.quote: while 129.5 million consumers shopped in stores, up 3 percent year-over-year.

facts.fact: In-store shoppers on Black Friday 2025 totaled 80.3 million, below the 81.7 million who shopped in stores on Black Friday the prior year.
facts.quote: In-store shoppers totaled 80.3 million on Friday, below the 81.7 million shoppers last year

facts.fact: Online shoppers on Black Friday 2025 numbered 85.7 million, according to the NRF survey.
